### Watermelon Generator

> Trigger words: `suika` / `すいか` / `スイカ` / `西瓜` / `suica`

- An omikuji in the style of Hungry Studio's "Merge Big Watermelon" or Aladdin X's "Suika Game". Compete for the highest score.
- Lots of fruit rains down (don't forget to install WordParty for OmikujiBot!).
  - No special action is needed. Also, fruit that sticks together doesn't evolve (it's just an effect).
- On a high score, a huge number of watermelons fall!

### Pumpkin Generator

> Trigger words: `かぼちゃ` / `カボチャ` / `南瓜` / `pumpkin`

- An omikuji in the style of Aladdin X's "Suika Game". Compete for the highest score.
- A variant of the Watermelon Generator. Candy 🍬 and pumpkins 🎃 are added. The more they appear, the higher the score, right!?
- Pumpkins are red-hot! 10,000 points is within reach!?

### Whale Generator

> Trigger words: `くじら` / `クジラ` / `鯨` / `whale`

- An omikuji in the style of NekokujiraLab's "Whale Game Online". Compete for the highest score.
- A high-risk, high-return mode, unlike the watermelon and pumpkin generators.
- On a high score, lots of whales appear! Beware of the mischievous orcas.
